Risk description: Former staff could retain access to internal systems
Root cause: Conflicting checklists and no accountable final approver
Mitigation action: Reconcile all leavers and enforce centrally tracked revocation

Risk description: Former staff could reach internal services through retained VPN access
Root cause: VPN membership is omitted from the exit checklist
Mitigation action: Remove the three known entitlements and reconcile VPN against HR records

Risk description: Exploitation of unpatched file server flaws could expose or disrupt customer shipping records
Root cause: No patch schedule or maintenance ownership
Mitigation action: Prioritize the file server, apply approved remediation and rescan

Risk description: Severe findings could recur or remain unresolved across Meridian assets
Root cause: No tracked scan-to-ticket workflow or recurring review
Mitigation action: Configure recurring scan cadence and assign remediation tickets and exceptions

Risk description: ShipDesk could process or expose delivery records without adequate contractual safeguards
Root cause: Auto-renewal and missing security terms and assurance review
Mitigation action: Review renewal options and obtain signed security terms and scoped assurance evidence

Risk description: Vendor support could access delivery records beyond a legitimate support need
Root cause: Support access can occur at any time and review evidence is unavailable
Mitigation action: Require approval, expiration and logging and verify with a synthetic test
